name: Docker
description: Manage Docker containers, images, volumes, networks and Compose, with built-in DBX AI and MCP tools for queries and permission-controlled operations.
releaseNotes: Adds built-in DBX AI Agent and external MCP tools with default-off per-connection permissions; resource details and network/volume management; YAML Compose editing, compact themed tables, file menus/previews and unified transfer tasks; backend preview/confirmation gates for destructive operations. Adds Windows named pipes, optional OS-default local sockets and native Windows pipe paths. Fixes SSH nc/sudo nc MaxSessions exhaustion with shared session limits, cancellable queues, idle expiry and bounded retries before Docker requests. Requires DBX 0.6.43 or newer.
